name: Christians Who Are Backslidden
overview: Scripture reveals that a backslider is one who turns away from God's will, becoming filled with their own ways rather than the Spirit of Christ, and thus is not truly His (Proverbs 14:14; Romans 8:9). While God has plans of peace and hope for His people (Jeremiah 29:11), merely professing faith without doing the Father's will does not grant entrance into His kingdom (Matthew 7:21). Believers who fall into sin are called to be gently restored by those who are spiritual, emphasizing humility and caution against temptation (Galatians 6:1). Salvation remains a gift of grace through faith, not based on our works, underscoring the need for continual dependence on God’s mercy (Ephesians 2:8).
